## Jarvis is file ko kaise use kare

1. Koi bhi naya kaam shuru karne se pehle yeh registry check karo (system prompt mein summary already maujood hai).
2. Agar koi matching module ya doc already available hai, wahi use karo — dobara se wahi cheez mat banao.
3. Agar kuch match nahi hota: pehle `read_project_doc` se related doc padho (agar lagta hai wahan info ho sakti hai).
   Agar wahan bhi kuch nahi milta to naya module/skill banao, phir `save_memory` se ek note category=`projects` mein
   save karo jisme yeh likha ho ke kya naya add hua — taake agli baar yeh registry rebuild ho to woh yahan bhi dikhe.
